# Sarang Vehale

> Portfolio, publications, and notes for Sarang Vehale, a researcher working across quantum information, cybersecurity, and scientific computing. Finishing a B.S. in Data Science at IIT Madras (expected May 2027) after completing an integrated B.Tech + M.Tech in Cyber Security at the National Forensic Sciences University (May 2026). Looking for research roles and PhD positions in quantum information theory, entropy, channels and coding.

This is a static, framework-free site (no build step, no backend). Every link below is plain Markdown, fetchable directly without executing JavaScript.

## Core

- [About](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/content/about.md): Bio, education, research focus.
- [Experience](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/content/experience.md): Research and teaching internships, with start/end dates.
- [Projects](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/content/projects.md): Software and research projects; problem, approach, and outcome for each.
- [Publications](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/content/publications.md): Papers and preprints, with authors, venue, DOI/arXiv ID, and status (published, under review, submitted, or accepted).
- [Skills](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/content/skills.md): Languages, frameworks, and tools.
- [Certificates](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/content/certificates.md): Courses and programs completed.
- [Contact](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/content/contact.md): How to reach out.
- [FAQ](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/content/faq.md): Short answers to common questions, including availability for work.
- [Resume (PDF)](https://sarangvehale.github.io/portfolio/resume.pdf)
